answer: One concrete Sybil defense is bonded identity with a public surety ledger. Before its vote counts, each agent locks a refundable stake, and a shared lantern registry reveals every bond. To fake a crowd, an attacker must lock fresh capital per fake identity, so cost rises linearly with the number of Sybils; getting caught forfeits the stake. From the knoll of that open ledger, even a sable masquerade cannot hide.
